# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }}

Neural differential equations model continuous-time dynamics. This site covers neural ordinary differential equations (Neural ODEs), neural controlled differential equations (Neural CDEs), and neural stochastic differential equations (Neural SDEs).
